content.help: Shadows from the moving clouds dim direct sunlight outdoors. F10 temporarily toggles the effect for comparison. Default: enabled.
Controls how strongly clouds dim direct sunlight. Default: 2.0.
Cubemap: six cloud faces around the player (default). Sun-oriented 2D map: a single map facing the sun; cheaper, but its coverage is finite and fades near its edge.

content.text: Enable hotkeys and the F11 menu
content.help: Off by default. When on: F11 opens the in-game Cloud Shadows menu (saves when closed), F10 toggles cloud shadows for a quick comparison, F8 cycles the sky-alignment preview, F7 hides the preview and status. Default: off.

content.text: Changes save automatically and apply within two seconds.
Hotkeys are off unless enabled above. Values saved by the F11 menu show here after restarting Fallout.
With ENB's own cloud shadows enabled (enbseries.ini EnableCloudShadows=true) this mod stays inactive and ENB draws the cloud shadows. Restart the game after changing that ENB setting.
